Situations where I step in

These situations are common. They are not inevitable.

📈

Your product is growing faster than your team

The app slows under load. Bugs pile up, customers complain. Your junior team does its best but hesitates before every deployment. You sense things are about to get worse, with no time to hire a full-time CTO.

⚠️

Your ageing internal tool has become a liability

Your system has been running for 5 to 15 years: critical but fragile. The developer who knew it well has left. Every change is expensive and time-consuming. Everyone is afraid to touch it. You know it will eventually block your operations.

🖥️

You need a professional website, fast

Your business deserves better than a generic template. I design and build a professional Symfony/React website, tailored to your project, priced before work starts. For freelancers, solopreneurs, and business leaders, no compromise on quality.

How I work

Concrete results, not jargon

No systematic overhaul. An honest assessment, a plan adapted to your resources, and team support to make the changes stick.

1

Honest audit

I take the time to understand your real situation: your business constraints, your team, your priorities. No rushed diagnosis, no unnecessary jargon.

2

Concrete recommendations

A clear action plan, prioritised, adapted to your resources and budget. You know exactly what will change, why, and in what order.

3

Team mentoring

I work with your developers, not in their place. They gain skills, adopt good practices, and can continue without me.

About

Matthieu Viel,
consultant based in Réunion Island

Based in Saint-Pierre since 2018, I know the local business landscape: its constraints, its realities, and its opportunities. I work on-site in Réunion (974) and remotely across France.

With 17 years of experience in web development (Symfony, React, PHP, API Platform), I've worked on high-traffic SaaS platforms (Citeo, Sellermania) as well as business applications and personal projects. My approach: understand first, recommend next, without making myself indispensable.
